facts.value: The children's library ceiling shows the night sky at 8 pm on 22 September, Asplund's birthday.
facts.quote: The ceiling painting in the first room shows the starry sky at 8 pm at the autumnal equinox on 22 September (Gunnar Asplund’s birthday)
